title: Kinetic Canvas & Design System
tagline: Interactive mathematical vector canvas and tactile UI framework.
summary: An interactive web application demonstrating custom 2D Canvas math, wave glyph distortion, and tactile brutalist design tokens. Built using React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and custom vector glyphs prepared in Adobe Illustrator.
detailedParagraphs: The Kinetic Canvas project emerged from a desire to break away from generic, homogeneous web templates and explore high-performance creative computing on the open web. By combining raw mathematical trigonometric functions with HTML5 Canvas and SVG filters, the engine generates real-time undulating wave meshes that react fluidly to cursor trajectory, scroll velocity, and device pixel ratios.

Under the hood, the rendering pipeline operates at a strict 60 FPS budget. Instead of relying on heavy third-party physics packages, the wave morphing calculations are written in pure TypeScript using optimized batch arrays and requestAnimationFrame loops. This ensures minimal CPU overhead and zero layout thrashing while rendering thousands of interconnected mathematical nodes simultaneously.

The visual design system bridges software architecture with bespoke graphic design. Design tokens were crafted using modern OKLCH color spaces to maintain perceptual luminance across dark modes, while the custom glyphs, icons, and brutalist geometric layout were prototyped in Adobe Illustrator before being serialized directly into zero-runtime React components.
problemStatement: Standard web design templates rely on repetitive gradient skins and sluggish DOM animations that lack distinctive brand identity and high-frame-rate tactile response.
solution: Engineered a custom Canvas / SVG shader pipeline in TypeScript paired with a strict OKLCH design token architecture and bespoke vector assets created in Illustrator & Photoshop.

title: Fullstack NestJS Commerce Platform
tagline: High-concurrency backend services with live streaming and order queues.
summary: A modular enterprise-grade REST architecture built with NestJS, Node.js, and TypeScript. Features JWT authentication, structured controllers, Prisma database schema, and React frontend integration with Tailwind styling.
detailedParagraphs: Designed as a resilient backend backbone for high-volume transactions, this platform addresses common bottlenecks in traditional e-commerce architectures: database connection pool exhaustion, unhandled concurrency spikes during flash sales, and loosely typed request pipelines.

The core service is structured using NestJS's modular dependency injection pattern. Repositories communicate with PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM, utilizing explicit transactions and optimistic locking to prevent race conditions during rapid inventory deductions. Authentication is enforced via stateless JWT tokens with automated refresh token rotation and granular role-based access control (RBAC) guards.

On the frontend, a reactive React 19 client connects seamlessly through strongly typed API contracts. Optimistic UI mutations ensure instant visual feedback for the user, while background synchronization handles reconciliation with the server, maintaining sub-50ms roundtrip response times.
problemStatement: Monolithic web backends frequently lock database tables during peak traffic, produce unvalidated payload errors, and suffer from unorganized spaghetti controllers.
solution: Designed a clean NestJS modular architecture with decoupled services, Prisma transactions, dependency injection, and responsive TypeScript interfaces.

title: PulseFlow Real-Time Biometrics App
tagline: Reactive cross-platform mobile application with live BLE telemetry charts.
summary: Cross-platform mobile application connecting to low-energy Bluetooth biomedical sensors, streaming high-frequency biometric signals, and rendering interactive GPU-accelerated vitals waveforms at 60 FPS.
detailedParagraphs: PulseFlow is a native-grade mobile application designed for athlete telemetry and real-time medical sensor monitoring. The application interfaces with BLE hardware sensors to ingest continuous ECG waveforms, blood oxygen levels, and dynamic heart rate variability metrics.

To prevent UI stutters caused by high-throughput Bluetooth packets (streaming up to 250 data points per second), all signal processing and noise filtering algorithms run in background worker threads. The filtered data feeds directly into custom Skia/Canvas drawing buffers, eliminating garbage collection pauses.
The user interface follows tactical dark-mode guidelines with high-contrast neon health indicators, offline-first SQLite cache synchronization, and biometric authentication security guards.
problemStatement: Traditional health apps struggle with high-frequency BLE data streams, causing frequent frame drops, battery drain, and unreadable chart renderings on mobile devices.
solution: Built an asynchronous multi-threaded data pipeline with hardware-accelerated charting shaders and battery-optimized Bluetooth polling algorithms.

title: Audio-Visual Brand Identity & Motion System
tagline: Dynamic video branding, kinetic motion graphics, and editorial photo grading.
summary: A comprehensive multimedia branding project combining custom vector identity, editorial color grading, and cinematic video editing. Produced in Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Lightroom with TypeScript web delivery.
detailedParagraphs: This multimedia design initiative created an uncompromising brand language spanning print, cinematic video, and interactive web mediums. The objective was to establish a cohesive visual universe with rhythmic kinetic motion and editorial color tonality.

Motion graphics were developed inside Adobe After Effects utilizing mathematical expression controllers to achieve organic spring physics and kinetic typography pacing at 60 FPS. Video assets were edited and sound-designed in Premiere Pro, featuring custom Foley audio and seamless cut pacing calibrated to visual hit points.

Still imagery underwent meticulous tonal calibration in Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop, utilizing custom 3D LUTs that balance deep obsidian shadows with glowing incandescent orange highlights. The resulting asset pipeline delivers ultra-lightweight WebM and animated SVG assets optimized for web performance without quality degradation.
problemStatement: Modern digital brands often lack unified kinetic motion principles, leading to disjointed video presentations and flat, uninspired visual branding.
solution: Created an integrated multimedia package with kinetic After Effects motion templates, Lightroom color presets, and vector logomarks in Illustrator.
